messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: need 3rd party sources for Wikipedia
parts:
I created the Wikipedia article for Stan, but
we don't have any of what Wikipedia calls "reliable
3rd party sources" for the information.

We need the NUTS paper to be published. Matt -- is
there anything the rest of us can do to help
get it out?

It would also help if we had something published
on Stan per se. It would create "legitimacy"
for people who only believe something if it's
peer reviewed.

The only citation for JAGS is a workshop paper,
and the citations for WinBUGS and OpenBUGS are
similarly minimal:

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Just_another_Gibbs_sampler

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WinBUGS

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenBUGS

So we might have been OK if the text for the
workshop paper on prob computing at NIPS were
available publicly. I couldn't find it, though.

- Bob
